notes: The candidates of the full-span zoo that are not among the recorded method documents of the repository: Lasso10 and the two combinations that read it (qa5, cdf5), and method 12 run on the wide-mlp64 rows (the full-span zoo's M12). Steps and order are those of the full-span zoo's lasso_zoo.py and gen_methods.py; the recorded Lasso script is imported unchanged.
base_model_notes: The full-span zoo took the bands and the scored rows from its 90-input model (f90); wide-mlp64 is that model here (87 inputs after the fill gate).
monitor_notes: The Lasso picks its penalty on the monitor band, so its bands come from the base model's fit document with the recorded split (refit_full_train removed, patience 50), exactly as the full-span zoo did.
